scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:kaal-core && npm run test:kaal-agent && npm run test:kaal-engineering && npm run test:kaal-changing && npm run test:kaal-install && npm run test:change-seal && npm run test:kaal-sealing && npm run check-kaal-config
scripts.seal-kaal-change: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js seal .kaal
scripts.list-sealed-changes: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js closed
scripts.seal-kaal-work: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js seal-work .kaal
scripts.state-kaal-change: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js state .kaal
scripts.close-kaal-change: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js close .kaal
scripts.check-kaal-changes: npm run build --prefix engineering/change-seal && node engineering/change-seal/dist/helpers/cli.js check .kaal
